title: Serum Biomarkers in Parkinson's Disease at Different Stages
official: Serum Biomarkers in Parkinson's Disease at Different Stages
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed with idiopathic PD according to Movement Disorders Society (MDS) criteria;
* Age: 18-80 years;
* Signature of informed consent to participate in this study

Exclusion criteria.

* Women pregnant
* Inflammatory or autoimmune diseases
sponsor: Fondazione Policlinico Universitario Agostino Gemelli IRCCS
